settings.question: What is physiological wellness?
settings.answer:
Physiological wellness is the practice of helping your nervous system regulate itself throughout the day.

Stress, screen time, travel, and busy schedules can keep your nervous system alert long after the moment has passed. Cast creates home and body care tools designed to support your nervous system during these everyday moments, helping you move into rest, recovery, or clearer focus.

settings.question: Is Cast aromatherapy?
settings.answer:
No. Aromatherapy is built around scent and mood. Cast is built around plant chemistry and how botanical compounds support your nervous system's physical state.

Every Cast formula begins with a 16-hour herbal infusion that extracts water-soluble botanical compounds before aromatic botanical compounds are layered into the formula. This creates a more complete botanical structure designed to support your nervous system throughout the day.

settings.question: How do Cast sprays work?
settings.answer:
Each formula combines two layers of botanical compounds.

Every spray begins with a 16-hour herbal infusion that extracts water-soluble plant compounds. Aromatic botanical compounds are then added to activate olfactory pathways that communicate with areas of your brain involved in nervous system regulation.

Together, these botanical layers are designed to support your nervous system during everyday moments such as before bed, during periods of stress, after travel, or following extended screen time.

settings.question: Why does every formula begin with a 16-hour herbal infusion?
settings.answer:
The herbal infusion extracts water-soluble botanical compounds that are not captured through essential oils alone. Many of these compounds have little or no aroma but remain an important part of the formula.

Beginning with plant chemistry allows us to build each formulation around physiological function before the aromatic botanicals are added.

settings.question: Which spray is right for me?
settings.answer:
Sleep Spray

Designed for evenings when you're ready for bed but your nervous system still feels alert.

Calm Spray

Designed for moments of stress, tension, or when you need to regain a sense of balance.

Clarity Spray

Designed for periods of mental fatigue, after travel, or following extended screen time when you need to refocus.

settings.question: Can I use more than one spray?
settings.answer:
Yes. Each spray is designed for a different physiological use state, so many people use more than one throughout the day.

For example, you might use Clarity after extended screen time, Calm during periods of stress, and Sleep as part of your evening routine.

settings.question: How do I use the sprays?
settings.answer:
Spray into the air around you or onto linens from an appropriate distance. Breathe normally and allow the botanical compounds to become part of your environment.

Use throughout the day whenever your chosen spray matches how your body is feeling.

settings.question: How long will one bottle last?
settings.answer: A 100 mL bottle typically lasts 2 to 3 months with regular daily use, depending on how often you spray.
